title: Certificate
help: One page to print, save as PDF, or send. It holds the proof, so anyone can check it.
part_name: Your name, and your ORCID iD if you linked one
link_help: A public link shows the same parts on a page of your community server, without your name.
draft_help: A zip with a manuscript in Markdown, LaTeX, and HTML, the figures, and a certificate for each finding. Anagram does not send it to a preprint server.
draft_files: Include the other files of the findings
draft_authors_help: One author on each line: the name, then a comma and the ORCID iD if there is one.
